name: Rent Manager
description: Rent Manager is property-management software for residential and commercial portfolios, combining leasing, residents, owners, maintenance, accounting, payments, reporting, communications, customization and third-party integrations.
agentUseSummary: Rent Manager is visible as an authentication-security preview. Relay will not collect a Rent Manager username or password or use its role-inherited API token until LCS supplies an approved least-privilege third-party credential lifecycle and exact customer database authorization contract.

capabilities.label: Review bounded Rent Manager access
capabilities.description: If LCS supplies an approved least-privilege third-party authorization contract, expose only exact-company, typed, bounded and privacy-redacted read tools.

blocked.label: Capture a Rent Manager username or password
blocked.description: Relay will not ask a customer or employee to provide interactive product credentials for an agent integration.

blocked.label: Use a role-inherited API token
blocked.description: Relay will not exchange or retain a broad user-authority token without granular scopes, immutable company binding and a documented lifecycle.

blocked.label: Access sensitive property data
blocked.description: Resident, applicant, owner, vendor, employee, address, location, lease, work-order, bank, accounting, payment, screening and communication data remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Change records or communicate
blocked.description: Creates, updates, deletes, charges, payments, files, messages, workflows and every other write or outbound communication remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Run raw or bulk WAPI12 requests
blocked.description: Arbitrary resources, filters, embeds, automatic pagination, raw responses and experimental endpoints are not exposed.

approvalProfiles.label: Rent Manager authentication security review
approvalProfiles.description: Connection, installation and agent actions remain unavailable because the documented WAPI12 login exchanges a Rent Manager username and password for a token whose access follows that user's database privileges.

runtimeSupport.description: No OpenClaw tools are callable under Rent Manager's documented username/password and role-inherited token contract.
No Hermes tools are callable under Rent Manager's documented username/password and role-inherited token contract.

providerSetup.blocker: Rent Manager's public WAPI12 document defines a company-subdomain REST API and requires clients to POST a Rent Manager username and password to AuthorizeUser, then send the returned API token on all requests. Resource access follows the authenticated user's privileges, while the API supports broad reads and writes across a property-management database. Public material does not define a granular scoped third-party credential, immutable database claims, token expiry, rotation, revocation or safe distribution contract.
providerSetup.nextAction: Ask LCS API Services for an approved production third-party authorization method that avoids interactive product-password capture and provides a dedicated service identity, immutable company/database binding, granular read-only permissions, secure issuance, expiration, rotation and revocation, rate limits, audit identifiers and distribution terms. Re-run privacy and security review before implementing only typed, bounded and redacted reads.

evidence.supports: The official WAPI12 overview documents company-subdomain REST resources, field selection, filtering, pagination, per-company rate limits and broad GET, POST and DELETE behavior.

The authentication section requires a username and password at Authentication/AuthorizeUser, returns an API token for subsequent requests, ties authorization to the user's permissions and invalidates the token when the user's permissions or password change.
Rent Manager describes its API as a read/write integration program managed through customer databases and used by approved API partners and vendors.

Rent Manager documents property-level privileges and sensitive resident data, including encrypted social-security and credit-card information, reinforcing the need for least-privilege authorization and strict field exclusions.
LCS describes personal, professional, financial, transactional and location information involving property managers, residents, owners, vendors and employees, supporting critical classification.
